svg.title: A made-up, undisturbed excavation
svg.desc: Top layer C contains a new floor and pots. Middle layer B contains charcoal and burnt roof wood. Bottom layer A contains an earlier floor and pottery. Lower layers formed first. Not to scale.

g.text: C: new floor and cooking pots
B: charcoal and burnt roof wood
Undisturbed layers. Made-up case. Not to scale.
